notes: web_api audit 2026-09-24: no conditional reason/justification requirements exist in this app. The only 'reason' inputs are optional free-text (project status-change activity note, ProjectController::changeStatus truncates at 2000 chars; UpgradeBackupIntegrity::normalizeReason). All server-required human fields (project name/customer_id, time-entry project_id/date/hours, customer name, member user_id, hourly rate, settlement target/token, access-policy lists) are unconditionally required and present in the web UI and companion create/edit surfaces. Mobile create idempotency uses clientRequestId (not a human-entered field).
